 08 Nov 2026

 Watch At Marassi, Genoa and AC Milan meet in the 11th round of Serie A , with kick-off at 3pm. Ruben Amorim's AC Milan beat Inter in the derby but lost at home to Ferencvaros in the Europa League. Daniele De Rossi's Genoa have won three consecutive games in the league. AC Milan sit fifth with 21 points, while Genoa are 12th with 13 points. Massa will referee , with Camplone on VAR.
